title: GLIO preanalytic proteomics protocol profile
description: Research-use-only metadata profile for traceable human brain tissue proteomics preanalytics; it validates declared metadata and never infers biology, identity, consent, diagnosis, kinase state, or treatment.

fields.title: Analytical sample identifier
fields.description: Opaque identifier for the exact analytical sample; it must not encode a name, clinical identifier, diagnosis, location, or treatment.

fields.title: Source specimen identifier
fields.description: Opaque identifier for the immediate source specimen from which the analytical sample was derived.

fields.title: Lineage node identifier
fields.description: Opaque node identifier resolved inside the separately governed identity-lineage artifact supplied in execution context.

fields.title: Lineage artifact digest
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the separately governed identity-lineage artifact retained as provenance; execution-context binding is authoritative.

fields.title: Treatment history reference identifier
fields.description: Opaque reference to an upstream treatment-history object; treatment facts remain outside this module and are never inferred here.

fields.title: Treatment history reference digest
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the referenced treatment-history object.

fields.title: Genomic context reference identifier
fields.description: Opaque reference to an upstream genomic-context object; variants and genomic conclusions remain owned upstream.

fields.title: Genomic context reference digest
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the referenced genomic-context object.

fields.title: Transcriptome context reference identifier
fields.description: Opaque reference to upstream transcriptome evidence retained for later discordance analysis without fusion in this module.

fields.title: Transcriptome context reference digest
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the referenced transcriptome-context object.

fields.title: PTM annotation reference identifier
fields.description: Opaque reference to upstream PTM annotations; this profile neither localizes nor scores modifications.

fields.title: PTM annotation reference digest
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the referenced PTM-annotation object.

fields.title: Specimen organism
fields.description: Declared organism for the source specimen using the profile's pinned NCBI Taxonomy subset.

fields.title: Specimen organism part
fields.description: Declared anatomical origin using the profile's pinned UBERON subset.

fields.title: Specimen material type
fields.description: Physical material class presented to the preanalytic workflow.

fields.title: Specimen collection method
fields.description: Procedure class by which the tissue specimen was collected; procedural details remain in the lineage artifact.

fields.title: Specimen preservation
fields.description: Preservation class controlling the fixation compatibility rules in this profile.

fields.title: Biological replicate index
fields.description: One-based replicate index within the declared experimental condition; pooling requires a distinct lineage node rather than a sentinel integer.

fields.title: Warm ischemia time
fields.description: Elapsed warm-ischemia interval reported by the source process; bounds are expressed in the reference unit minute.

fields.title: Cold ischemia time
fields.description: Elapsed cold-ischemia interval before stabilization; bounds are expressed in the reference unit minute.

fields.title: Specimen stabilization timestamp
fields.description: Offset-aware timestamp at which freezing or fixation began; time-zone omission is prohibited.

fields.title: Specimen storage temperature
fields.description: Declared storage temperature; bounds are expressed in the reference unit degree Celsius and do not assert stability.

fields.title: Specimen storage duration
fields.description: Elapsed duration from stabilization to analytical preparation; bounds are expressed in the reference unit hour.

fields.title: Specimen fixative
fields.description: Conditionally required for FFPE tissue and prohibited for frozen tissue in profile version 1.0.0.

fields.title: Specimen fixation duration
fields.description: Conditionally required for FFPE tissue and prohibited for frozen tissue; bounds are expressed in the reference unit hour.

fields.title: Sample-preparation protocol reference identifier
fields.description: Opaque reference to the immutable, approved sample-preparation procedure used for this analytical sample.

fields.title: Sample-preparation protocol digest
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the referenced sample-preparation procedure.

fields.title: Input tissue mass
fields.description: Tissue mass entering extraction; bounds are expressed in the reference unit milligram.

fields.title: Protein extraction method
fields.description: Controlled extraction workflow class; complete reagent and equipment details remain in the referenced protocol.

fields.title: Reduction reagent
fields.description: Controlled reduction reagent used before proteolysis.

fields.title: Alkylation reagent
fields.description: Controlled alkylation reagent used before proteolysis.

fields.title: Cleavage agent
fields.description: Proteolytic cleavage agent selected from the pinned HUPO-PSI MS controlled-vocabulary subset.

fields.title: Digestion duration
fields.description: Elapsed proteolysis duration; bounds are expressed in the reference unit hour.

fields.title: Digestion temperature
fields.description: Declared digestion temperature; bounds are expressed in the reference unit degree Celsius.

fields.title: Fractionation method
fields.description: Controlled peptide fractionation method; the value none requires fraction identifier 1.

fields.title: Mass-spectrometry assay identifier
fields.description: Opaque identifier for the exact acquisition run represented by the raw-data artifact.

fields.title: Proteomics acquisition method
fields.description: Acquisition strategy selected from the pinned PRIDE ontology subset supported for discovery proteomics.

fields.title: Quantification label
fields.description: Quantification label from the pinned HUPO-PSI MS subset; version 1.0.0 supports label-free samples only.

fields.title: Mass-spectrometer model
fields.description: Instrument model selected from the explicitly supported HUPO-PSI MS subset.

fields.title: Dissociation method
fields.description: MS/MS dissociation method selected from the pinned HUPO-PSI MS subset.

fields.title: Raw-data artifact reference identifier
fields.description: Opaque artifact identifier for the canonical acquisition file or bundle; no file content is copied into this profile.

fields.title: Raw-data artifact digest
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical acquisition file or bundle.

fields.title: Raw-data artifact format
fields.description: Declared canonical data representation; conformance does not parse or verify the referenced file.

fields.title: Fraction identifier
fields.description: One-based fraction index; use 1 when the preparation is not fractionated.

fields.title: Technical replicate index
fields.description: One-based index for repeated acquisitions of the same prepared sample; use 1 when no repeat was performed.

fields.title: Injection volume
fields.description: Volume injected into the LC-MS system; bounds are expressed in the reference unit microlitre.

fields.title: LC gradient duration
fields.description: Programmed liquid-chromatography gradient duration; bounds are expressed in the reference unit minute.

fields.title: LC column temperature
fields.description: Declared chromatographic column temperature; bounds are expressed in the reference unit degree Celsius.

fields.title: Preanalytic quality report reference identifier
fields.description: Opaque reference to the separately governed pathology and laboratory quality report.

fields.title: Preanalytic quality report digest
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the referenced preanalytic quality report.

fields.title: Pathology review status
fields.description: Declared review state for the solid-tissue quality report; any state other than completed requires human review.

fields.title: Tumor cellularity
fields.description: Conditionally required when pathology review is completed; numeric percentage points reported by the referenced quality process.

fields.title: Necrosis
fields.description: Conditionally required when pathology review is completed; numeric percentage points reported by the referenced quality process.

fields.title: Extracted protein yield
fields.description: Total extracted protein mass reported by the preparation process; bounds are expressed in the reference unit microgram.

fields.title: Extracted protein concentration
fields.description: Protein concentration reported by the preparation process; bounds are expressed in the reference unit microgram per microlitre.

units.definition: UCUM percent; numeric inputs are percentage points and are converted against reference unit percent.
UCUM microgram using the ASCII u prefix.
UCUM microlitre using the ASCII u prefix.
UCUM degree Celsius with affine conversion semantics.

compatibility_rules.description: FFPE tissue requires an explicit supported fixative.
FFPE tissue requires an explicit fixation duration.
Frozen-tissue records cannot declare a fixative under this profile.
Frozen-tissue records cannot declare a fixation duration under this profile.
A non-completed pathology-review state is retained and escalated to human review.
Completed pathology review requires reported tumor cellularity.
Completed pathology review requires reported necrosis.
An unfractionated preparation uses the SDRF-compatible fraction identifier 1.

limitations.statement: This profile is for research metadata conformance only and is not a clinical device, diagnosis, prognosis, or medical record.
Conformance establishes that declared metadata satisfies this profile; it does not verify laboratory truth, specimen quality, or referenced file content.
This module does not estimate, own, or relabel kinase activity or kinase state.
Treatment history is represented only by an opaque upstream reference; no treatment recommendation or response inference is produced.
Genomic, transcriptomic, and PTM objects remain separate upstream references; this module performs no cross-omics fusion.
Version 1.0.0 supports human brain solid tissue only; fluids, cultured models, single cells, and non-human specimens are outside support.
Version 1.0.0 supports label-free bottom-up DDA or DIA using the explicitly enumerated instruments, cleavage agents, and dissociation methods only.
External ontologies are pinned to reviewed subsets; live ontology membership and newly added terms are not accepted implicitly.
Identifiers must be opaque and non-identifying; direct identifiers and clinical narratives are outside this artifact.
Unknown, redacted, unsupported, or absent evidence remains unresolved and cannot be interpreted as a negative biological finding.
